name: Echidna Wars DX
storyline: Ryonazawa City is suddenly invaded by interdimensional creatures known as the Echidna. As the city falls into chaos, four heroines rise to confront the threat, rescue the citizens, and restore peace. These heroines must fight their way through waves of monsters who restrain and devour any who stand in their way.
summary:
Echidna Wars DX (Japanese: ミリア戦記DX, Milia Senki DX)is a 2D side-scrolling beat-'em-up action video game developed by ASIMOFU and D-Gate, released on December 31, 2016, exclusively for PC.

Echidna Wars DX is a pixel-art, side-scrolling action game with beat-'em-up mechanics. Players control one of four heroines (Mirea, Sachiho, Usaco and TGO-07), battling through three main stages, each divided into smaller areas with a boss at the end.
